connector.name: MockHero
connector.registryDescription: Generate realistic relational test data - 156 field types, 22 locales, JSON/CSV/SQL, free previews.
connector.summary: Hosted at mockhero.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dinosaur24 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MOCKHERO_API_KEY
env.description: MockHero API key (optional — without it, generation runs as a free preview up to 100 records per request; get a key at https://mockhero.dev or via the create_agent_checkout tool)

env.name: MOCKHERO_API_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the MockHero API (default https://mockhero.dev)
